newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Yizheng says no restructure plan.
newsitem.headline: China's Yizheng says no restructure plan.

text.p: Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd said on Thursday the company has no plan to restructure or merge with any other chemical companies.
"We are going to publish an announcement in Hong Kong to clearly state that we are not going to merge with any other chemical firms," a company spokesman told Reuters.
"We also have not received any notification from higher level administrators about any restructuring," she said from the company's headquarters in Jiangsu province.
Trading in Yizheng's H shares was suspended on Thursday at the company's request, pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said.
Yizheng's shares traded in Hong Kong surged HK$0.725 or 38.16 percent to HK$2.625 on Wednesday on volume of 218.01 million shares worth HK$500 million.
Yizheng's domestic currency A shares listed on the Shanghai stock exchange continued to trade on Thursday and they soared 0.28 yuan to 4.97 yuan shortly before the close.
Brokers said the shares of the big polyester maker were buoyed by rumours of a financial restructuring. ($1 = 8.3 yuan) ($1 = HK$7.8) -- Shanghai newsroom (8621) 6279-7004
